text:
Aisha CSM: quick heads-up — Lumina renewal slated 04/15. Procurement surfaced two items: their AP wants vendor master code LUM-900 while our quote shows RDW-GLOBAL, and they need the vendor onboarding packet attached to the PO. current order value $198,750.
Tom RevOps: thanks. can you paste the quote/invoice metadata so I can confirm billing entity and invoice id?
Aisha CSM: sure — from sales quote:
``
Quote ID: Q-2026-4471
Invoice target: INV-2026-1144
Billing entity: Redwood Inference, Inc.
Amount: $198,750
Listed vendor code: RDW-GLOBAL
Requested PO ref: LUM-BPO-2026-07
```
Evan (Lumina): confirmed — our vendor master has LUM-900. procurement says for invoices > $150k they route extra approvals and require onboarding attached.
Marta Finance: Evan — can you upload the onboarding PDF and confirm whether your AP will accept our vendor name and reference LUM-900 in the PO?
Evan (Lumina): asked AP. Two options: (A) keep vendor name as Redwood Inference, Inc. and put LUM-900 in PO reference field, or (B) change their vendor master entry to RDW-GLOBAL. They prefer (A) to avoid master data churn.
Priya Legal: contract POV — we can change the vendor code on invoice if billing entity and tax ID remain Redwood Inference, Inc. But finance needs written authorization from Lumina for whichever path they pick. @Aisha please capture that approval email.
Tom RevOps: FYI — internal threshold: invoices >= $200k require CFO wet signature on amendments. Right now we're under, but seat adds could push above. We should prepare both e-sign and wet-sign plans.
Aisha CSM: noted — I'll ask sales to confirm final seat count immediately. if we cross $200k we'll need wet-sign logistics.
esign-bot: DocuSign envelope queued: https://docusign.example/envelope/abc123 (status: draft).
Evan (Lumina): procurement uploaded LUM_vendor_onboarding_v2.pdf and created PO draft LUM-BPO-2026-07_DRAFT.pdf. they will accept option (A) — will include LUM-900 in the PO reference field and attach onboarding.
Marta Finance: that works for us. we can reconcile if the vendor master name is Redwood Inference, Inc. and LUM-900 is only a reference. Please ensure onboarding PDF is attached to the final PO.
Priya Legal: action items: 1) Lumina to email explicit approval that PO reference field is acceptable (no vendor master change), 2) Aisha to save that email to the contract folder, 3) if final invoice >= $200k confirm wet-sign route or CFO email approval for e-sign.
Tom RevOps: timeline: renewal 04/15 — we need final PO + onboarding by 04/08 to hit billing cutoff. if seats increase and we cross $200k, we need amendment signed by 04/05 to allow courier.
Aisha CSM: I'll chase sales and procurement. keeping this thread as single source of truth.
Evan (Lumina): sales called — may add 3 seats (+~$48k) but not yet signed. procurement said they'll try to finalize the PO now and will route amendment to CFO if seat tally changes. I'll post the approval email here once AP confirms.
Aisha CSM: contingency checklist: [ ] final seat count, [x] onboarding uploaded, [x] PO draft created, [ ] customer approval email about PO ref, [ ] amendment signed (e-sign or wet). escalate to AM/SE if unresolved by 04/08.
Evan (Lumina): posted procurement approval: "We accept 'Redwood Inference, Inc.' as vendor master and will include LUM-900 in the PO reference field. Attached BPO pending final seat qty." will attach PDF to the PO and cc this thread.
